mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in payroll employment signals a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer spending and business investment, which depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE increases and PAYEMS decreases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market downturn (HOUST below 550,000 units) signals reduced consumer spending and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 550.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real consumer spending (RSAFS) correlates with rising corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS increases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index, 2017=100) signals a manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) rises faster than the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS), it erodes real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > FEDFUNDS change, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a labor market recovery (UNRATE falling below 5.0% and PAYEMS rising), consumer confidence and spending increase, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0 and PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
